manufacturer_data.description: Company ID 0xEC88 (= 60552; magic bytes 88 EC in the manufacturer-specific AD structure — the APK broadcast parser requires them). Govee parses a 'goodsType' value from this structure (2 bytes at offset +5/+6, BleUtil.parseBleBroadcastPact); the bulb family is goodsType=20. A previous revision listed 63678 (0xF8BE), which matches nothing in the APK or any public source.

device.name: Govee H6001 Smart Bulb
device.notes: BLE-only smart bulb from Govee's legacy bulb family (H6001, H6005; H6101/H6104 are sibling classes with a different GATT profile). Protocol uses 20-byte fixed packets with XOR checksum in final byte. Command prefixes: 0x33 (control) and 0xAA (ACK/keep-alive — the app sends AA 01 00..00 AB every ~2 s while connected). 0xA3 (extended) exists in the wider Govee family but has not been captured on H6001. The app's internal namespace "com.ihoment.base2app" reveals Govee's corporate identity as iHoment/Shenzhen Intellirocks. GATT: service 00010203-0405-0607-0809-0a0b0c0d1910, write char …2b11, notify char …2b10 — from on-device HCI-snoop RE of a real H6001 (chvolkmann/govee_btled bluetooth_led.py), the egold555 H6127.md UUID table, and the blog.coding.kiwi GATT dump. In the APK, H6001 routes via OldBulbUtil + the generic com.govee.rgblight path (00010203 scheme); the 0xFFE0/0xFFE1 UUIDs belong to the H6101/H6104 BleComm classes, not to H6001. GROUP CONTROL: the Govee Home app can address several bulbs at once — The app's group-control helper writes group commands to characteristic 0xFFE1 under service 0xFFE0. That is the H6101/H6104 sibling GATT profile, not the H6001's own 00010203-…-1910 profile, so group control applies to FFE0-family bulbs (app-derived, not hardware-verified on H6001). CONFIDENCE: HIGH for command format and GATT profile (on-device captures, corroborated by multiple independent RE efforts); the advertised name pattern is unconfirmed (siblings advertise ihoment_<model>_<hex>; Minger-branded H6001s exist).

credentials.notes: BLE-only; no WiFi passphrase crosses the link. The bulb accepts open writes from any connected central, so control is available to anyone in range.

factory_reset.description:
Nobody has run this against an H6001, so treat the procedure below as the thing to try first rather than the thing that works. Rapid power cycling is the near-universal reset for mains-powered smart bulbs, and it is what the Govee app's own help text points users at, but the exact toggle count varies across the family and was not recovered from the APK — some generations want five cycles, others three.
In practice this costs nothing to attempt: if the count is wrong the bulb simply comes back on in its previous state, and you can try again. The signal that it took is the bulb blinking on its own and then re-advertising as unprovisioned. If it powers up normally with no blink, the sequence did not register.
factory_reset.effect: Returns the bulb to factory defaults, clearing any stored scene or colour state.

procedures.basis: The generic pattern for mains-powered smart bulbs, consistent with Govee's published help text. Not recovered from the decompiled app and not confirmed on hardware.
procedures.description: Switch the bulb off and on at the wall or lamp switch in quick succession, pausing about a second in each state. Watch for a self-initiated blink at the end — that, not the bulb simply lighting, is what confirms the reset.
procedures.indicator: Bulb blinks by itself, then re-advertises as unprovisioned.
procedures.name: Power cycle

steps.action: Toggle power rapidly 5 times, roughly one second on and one second off.
steps.expect: Bulb blinks to confirm reset and re-advertises. If it just comes back on unchanged, the count is wrong for this generation — try three cycles instead.

methods.description: No provisioning needed. Power on, scan, connect, write.

steps.action: Power the bulb and scan for BLE advertisements.
Connect to the device and write control commands.

setup.notes: No pairing or bonding required. Device advertises on power-up and accepts open BLE writes from any connected central.

rejoin.notes: The bulb is BLE-only and joins no network, so there is nothing to rejoin. No bond is held: any central may connect once the previous one disconnects.

keep_alive.description: Connection keep-alive, sent every ~2 s (H6127.md). Packet: [0xAA, 0x01, 0x00*17, 0xAB]

brightness.notes: Raw wire value. The vendor app maps its 1%-100% slider onto roughly 0x14-0xFE.

checksum.description: XOR of the preceding 19 frame bytes; encoder-filled, never a control.

set_color.description: Set RGB color (mode byte 0x02 = manual). Packet: [0x33, 0x05, 0x02, <R>, <G>, <B>, 0x00*13, <xor>]

checksum.description: XOR of the preceding 19 frame bytes; encoder-filled, never a control.

set_color_white.description: White / color-temperature control via fixed warm/cold shades (not arbitrary Kelvin). Packet: [0x33, 0x05, 0x02, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x01, <shade R>, <shade G>, <shade B>, 0x00*9, <xor>] — the 0x01 flag selects the warm/cold-white LED set. The shade triple is picked from the vendor's fixed table rather than computed from a Kelvin value (govee_btled set_color_white).

checksum.description: XOR of the preceding 19 frame bytes; encoder-filled, never a control.

characteristics.name: Control Write
characteristics.notes: Primary write characteristic for all control commands. Commands are 20-byte fixed-length packets, byte 19 = XOR of bytes 0-18. Every command below spells its frame out in full: a short write is not a shorter command, it is a rejected one. App sends keep-alive AA 01 00..00 AB every ~2 s while connected. Additional color-mode sub-commands (H6127.md, explicitly deferred to by H6001.md): music 0x01, scene 0x04, DIY 0x0a; mic mode 0x06 in govee_btled's LedMode.

characteristics.name: Control Notify
characteristics.notes: Read/notify characteristic paired with …2b11 (ACKs and responses).

services.name: Govee Legacy Bulb Service
services.notes: On-device GATT profile of the H6001 (HCI-snoop confirmed). The 0xFFE0/0xFFE1 profile listed in earlier revisions belongs to the H6101/H6104 classes in the APK, not to H6001.

services.name: Govee OTA Service
services.notes: Firmware update service. Not needed for control. Present in the APK (OtaManagerV1) and H6001 gained OTA capability in newer firmware, but no public H6001 GATT dump confirms 0xfd00 on-device — treat as unverified.
